units.source_text: 命妇回宫，见皇上犹未就寝，觉得十分可怜。

en.t: When Myobu returned to the palace and saw that the Emperor still had not gone to bed, she felt deeply sorry for him.

units.source_text: 此时清凉殿庭院中秋花秋草，正值繁茂。

en.t: At that time, the autumn flowers and grasses in the garden of the Seiryoden were at the height of their growth.

units.source_text: 皇上装作观赏模样，带着四五个性情温雅的女官，静悄悄地闲谈消遣。

en.t: The Emperor pretended to be admiring the garden, and with four or five gentle-tempered ladies-in-waiting, quietly passed the time in conversation.

units.source_text: 近来皇上晨夕披览的，是《长恨歌》画册。

en.t: Recently, the book the Emperor had been leafing through morning and evening was an illustrated album of The Song of Everlasting Sorrow.

units.source_text: 这是从前宇多天皇命画家绘制的，

en.t: It had been painted long ago by artists at the command of Emperor Uda,

units.source_text: 其中有著名诗人伊势[\[13\]](#part1330.html#m13)和贯之[\[14\]](#part1330.html#m14)所作的和歌[\[15\]](#part1330.html#m15)及汉诗。

en.t: and it contained waka and Chinese poems composed by the famous poets Ise[\[13\]](#part1330.html#m13) and Tsurayuki[\[14\]](#part1330.html#m14).

units.source_text: 日常谈话，也都是此类话题。

en.t: Their everyday conversations, too, were all about such subjects.

units.source_text: 此时看见命妇回宫，便细问桐壶更衣娘家情状。

en.t: When he saw Myobu return to the palace, he asked her in detail about conditions at the family home of the Kiritsubo Intimate.

units.source_text: 命妇即将所见悲惨景象悄悄奏闻。

en.t: Myobu then quietly reported to him the pitiful scene she had witnessed.

units.source_text: 皇上展读太君复书，但见其中写道：“辱承锦注，诚惶诚恐，几无置身之地。

en.t: The Emperor unfolded and read the lady's reply, and saw that it said: "I am deeply humbled to have received your gracious letter, and I am so awed and fearful that I scarcely know where to place myself.

units.source_text: 拜读温谕，悲感交集，心迷目眩矣。

en.t: Reading your warm words, I am overcome by sorrow and gratitude together; my heart is bewildered and my eyes grow dim.
